clips.title: The story
paras: The Ashenvale Hunt is a summons dispatched to young Horde champions visiting Thunder Bluff, urging them north into the dense canopy of Ashenvale. Delivered by the city's heralds, the call directs travelers to report to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post to take part in a proving hunt.

Within the serene heights of Thunder Bluff, runners keep the burgeoning Horde informed of opportunities beyond the borders of Mulgore. Bluff Runner Windstrider carries an open invitation aimed at proven adventurers looking for greater challenges. With the Horde establishing footholds deep in the ancient forest north of the Barrens, young warriors are called upon to bolster those outposts and test their survival skills in a far harsher environment.

Ashenvale represents both rich resources and severe peril for the Horde. Two prominent encampments anchor the faction's presence in the territory: Splintertree Post along the main road, and a remote outpost perched upon the western coast at Zoram Strand. Arriving at Splintertree Post puts incoming recruits directly under the wing of Senani Thunderheart, a veteran outdoorswoman organizing a massive hunt designed to tame the wilderness and claim glory for the Horde.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Attention, young adventurers! The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens. Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde! Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there. Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the new frontier, friend. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young adventurer like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.
Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
